pages: ® Generac Power Systems S45W29290 Highway 59 Waukesha, WI 53189 Dear Valued Customer, Congratulations on your new Generac Home Standby Generator! We are confident that your new generator will provide you and your family many years of peace of mind and give you the security of knowing that if your power ever goes out, you and your family are protected. Due to an ongoing global shortage and inconsistent supply of microprocessor chips, we are shipping your generator without the component that enables it to connect to your Wi-Fi network and communicate to the Mobile Link Remote Monitoring app. Your generator is fully operational without this Wi-Fi component. We currently hope to ship this component directly to you within the next six months (or as soon as possible), along with easy-to-follow instructions for simple, do-it-yourself installation. To ensure we are sending the component to the correct address, please scan the QR code below or visit www.generac.com/wifikit to confirm your address and generator serial number. Thank you again for your purchase and trust in the Generac brand and we apologize for the inconvenience. If you have any questions, please contact us at 888-GENERAC. Generac Power Systems, Inc.
